intake.name: intake
intake.textSnippet: You should see a Shark, a Fish and a score stuck on 0. The little pictures at the bottom right are the game's SPRITES — a sprite is one character or thing in the game. Click a sprite and you will see
intake.contentAnchor: You should see a Shark, a Fish and a score stuck on 0. The little pictures at the bottom right are the game's SPRITES — a sprite is one character or thing in the game. Click a sprite and you will see its SCRIPTS: the stacks of blocks that tell that sprite what to do. Every sprite carries its OWN scripts, never anyone else's — that is why a bug can hide on one sprite while everything else looks fine. One more word you WILL meet on the Fish: CLONE. A clone is a temporary copy of a sprite that Scratch makes while the game runs — every fish swimming in the water is a clone of the one Fish sprite in the list. Most of the bugs are hiding in the sprites' scripts — but not all of them: one case will take you somewhere new.
